events.originalDescription: Taking place twice a year at Paris, Le Bourget, the Fairyland For Fashion offer to thousands of professional buyers from all over the world a rich variety of products. Apparel Sourcing Paris is the leading clothing sourcing platform for the European market which offers a wide range of products for men, women, and children, including Shawls&Scarves, specialized in accessories from the traditional to the most imaginative. Avantex Paris help fashion players to remain competitive in a constantly changing context thanks to high-tech products and innovation, from advanced materials to augmented retail. Moreover, some catwalks showcase a vast array of garments and accessories from selected manufacturers, shown in a contextualized scenography which evolves according to seasons.
